subject: Tenant data sunset / deletion certification request — TrustBank (SOC2)
messages:
From: Olivia Mendez <olivia.mendez@trustbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@trustbank.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for deletion certification and proof (Tenant 772)

Hi Karthik,

As part of our upcoming SOC2 audit we need a certification package showing that tenant 772 was fully deprovisioned on 2026-09-15 and that all retained artifacts were deleted according to the agreed retention windows. Specifically we need:

- A retention matrix that maps tenant 772 data types to retention TTLs and locations.
- Deletion logs (timestamps + object ids) for primary storage and backups.
- Hashlist or cryptographic proof showing the snapshot used for deletion verification.
- Any KMS key rotation / access revocation entries tied to the tenant.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Audit window is the week of Oct 5.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Mendez
Senior Audit Manager, TrustBank

---
We typically accept zipped CSVs or signed attestations. If you prefer, we can accept temporary shared drive access to an evidence folder.

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Mendez <olivia.mendez@trustbank.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for deletion certification and proof (Tenant 772)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all items but want to confirm a few scope points before we assemble the package: 

1) Backups: do you require deletion logs for snapshot-level backups retained >30 days (archival cold-backups), or only active snapshot deletions (within 30 days)? Our backup lifecycle is documented in the retention matrix but the logs differ by storage tier.

2) KMS artifacts: we can provide key-access audit events and revocation entries. Are you expecting an HSM-signed attestation or exported audit events (CSV)?

3) Delivery method: we will stage artifacts in a secured evidence folder and provide a short verification checklist + a signed attestation. Would a single zip plus a short manifest be acceptable?

I will loop in Neha for the retention mapping and Vivek for deletion-log sampling. Target ETA: initial evidence folder by 2026-10-01 EOD, final signed attestation by 2026-10-02. If you need faster, let us know which items have top priority.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching the retention matrix and a small sample deletion log for tenant 772. Notes: 

- retention-matrix-TrustBank-v2.xlsx: maps data class (logs, embeddings, chat history, backups) -> TTL and storage region. TTLs are applied at object store lifecycle rules and at DB/kv-layer.
- deletion-log-sample-tenant-772.csv: redacted sample with object_id, deletion_timestamp_utc, storage_tier, checksum. This is a 100-row sample; full export will be produced as a CSV export.
- proof-hashlist-20261001.txt: SHA256 list for the snapshot used to validate deletion (signed by our evidence process).

A few clarifications we logged while preparing the exports:
- Cold-archive backups are retained for 90 days for TrustBank by contract; deletions for archive objects are handled by the archival provider and show up in the archival audit feed (separate export).
- We will include KMS key-access events (CSV) and the key rotation document; we do not provide HSM-signed certificates by default but can coordinate with our cryptography team if the auditor requires that.

ETA: I will upload the full CSV export + manifest to the shared evidence folder by 2026-10-01 18:00 PT. Expect a signed attestation (PDF) from Legal & Trust by 2026-10-02 12:00 PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-matrix-TrustBank-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), deletion-log-sample-tenant-772.csv (csv), proof-hashlist-20261001.txt (text)

Thanks Neha — that looks good. Quick follow-up: for one of our control samples we need an explicit proof that the deletion operation for object id OBJ-77-90 occurred on 2026-09-15 at 03:42:10 UTC and that the corresponding KV cache entry was evicted. Can you include the deletion event id, storage region, and the cache-eviction log snippet?

Also, are the hashes in proof-hashlist signed by an evidence signing key? We need a verifiable signature (pgp or equivalent) for the artifact used in the auditor report.

Olivia

Olivia — thanks for the question. We pulled the specific artifacts you requested and uploaded them to the evidence folder. Summary of what is included in the final package (zipped):

- Full retention matrix (spreadsheet) and a short readme describing lifecycle rules.
- deletion-log-tenant-772-full.csv: full deletion export including object_id, deletion_timestamp_utc, storage_region, deletion_event_id, operator_id (service account), checksum. (Redacted PII where applicable.)
- cache-eviction-snippets.txt: sample KV cache eviction entries showing OBJ-77-90 eviction at 2026-09-15T03:42:11Z (one second after object deletion).
- proof-hashlist-20261001.txt (SHA256 list) and proof-hashlist-20261001.sig (detached GPG signature from our evidence-signing key).
- kms-access-events.csv: exported access events for the keys referenced in tenant 772, plus a link to the key-rotation document.
- signed-attestation-TrustBank-tenant-772.pdf: statement of deletion signed by our Legal & Trust team.

Delivery: folder shared at https://redwood-drive.example.com/TrustBank/evidence/2026-09/tenant-772/ with temporary read-only access valid until 2026-11-01. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/TrustBank (linked).

If the auditor requires an HSM-signed certificate for the hashlist, we can arrange a bridged signature through our crypto team — that would take an extra 48 business hours. Please confirm whether the detached GPG signature suffices for now.

Regards,
Karthik
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
